title: Before you enable anything
lead: Before you enable modules, read what each one does and review the .md files it adds. You're in control and can turn anything off later.
licence: The console and its setup are provided as-is under the Apache-2.0 licence. The author isn't liable for what they do on your machine.

safeguards.text: Nothing is written until the final Apply step; every change is shown first.
Adopting an existing project works on a copy; your original stays untouched until you promote it.
Every module and every change has its own yes or no.
Each apply saves what it replaces, and revert puts it back byte for byte.
Files the profile created go to the Recycle Bin when removed, never straight to deletion.
Nothing about you or your work is sent anywhere.
Stop everything halts the console's processes, profile tasks and hooks (small scripts Claude runs before or after its actions) in one step.
